name: Rye Y Camp
description_short: Rye YMCA day camp at Osborn School in Rye running Discovery (ages 4 to 11), Sports (ages 5 to 12) and STEAM (ages 6 to 11) programs, with swim lessons most days at the Y, sports, science, arts and weekly field trips for all but the youngest group.
notes: Camp 9 am to 4 pm; extended care 7:30 to 9 am and 4 to 6 pm, registered by the week. Campers are bused to the Y for swimming. Lunch can be bought by the week or packed from home. Kinder Camp (ages 2 to 5) runs at the Rye Y (21 Locust Avenue) and in Mamaroneck (122 Fenimore Rd.), and teen programs serve grades 6 to 10; those are not part of this listing. 2026 rates are published only as an image flipbook that could not be read.

Researched by Claude from this page. Discovery Camp page: swim lessons, instructional sports, science, arts, music; weekly trips for groups from completed kindergarten up. It calls Discovery a traditional day camp.
